Method of Attack: Distributing Magniber ransomware via fake Windows 10 update installers; ransomware deletes shadow volume copies and encrypts files with random 8-character extensions; creates ransom notes README.html with instructions to access Magniber Tor payment site
Attack Vector: Fake Windows 10 update installers distributed from fake warez and crack sites
Indicators of Compromise: Fake update package names: Win10.0_System_Upgrade_Software.msi, Security_Upgrade_Software_Win10.0.msi, System.Upgrade.Win10.0-KB47287134.msi, System.Upgrade.Win10.0-KB82260712.msi, System.Upgrade.Win10.0-KB18062410.msi, System.Upgrade.Win10.0-KB66846525.msi
Encrypted files appended with random 8-character extensions such as .gtearevf
Ransom note file named README.html in encrypted folders
Magniber Tor payment site titled 'My Decryptor'
